name: strategy_key
description: Stable readable key a record carried in the frozen v12 strategy roadmap.

aiGuidance.purpose: Keeps the v12 roadmap's readable keys (F1, G3, semantic-kernel, f1-model) findable after migration, since record create mints new instanceIds.
aiGuidance.extraction: Copy the key verbatim from the v12 source (the `id` property). Never invent one for new records.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Not an identity: the instanceId is. Do not put a title or sentence here.
